sloka: प्रविष्ट मात्रे ज्ञातो अहम् बले तस्मिन्न् अचारिते ।बलाद् गृहीतो बहुभिर् बहुधा अस्मि विदारितः ॥६-३०-७॥।।
transliteration: praviṣṭa mātre jñāto aham bale tasminn acārite ।balād gṛhīto bahubhir bahudhā asmi vidāritaḥ ॥6-30-7॥।।

translations.english: "No sooner I entered their army, I was detected. I was forcibly seized by their guards and rolled on the ground."
